intro: Most absence starts long before the sick report. With rising workload, a workplace that is not right or worries at home. With React2u Resist you see it earlier and act in time.

We start with a clear picture of your organisation: what the risks are, how your people are doing and what the law requires. In the Netherlands every employer must have a risk assessment (RI&E) and offer a preventive medical examination (PMO). Then we choose together the measures that really make a difference.
